facts.effigy: A stone figure of a knight lies on a tomb with both hands joined on the chest in a prayer pose.
facts.three-swords-wall: On the wall above, three swords hang with their tips pointing down.
facts.fourth-sword: A fourth sword is carved horizontally on the side of the tomb.
facts.stained-glass: In the stained-glass window at the upper left, a kneeling person and a figure blessing him are drawn.
facts.eyes-closed: The eyes of the lying knight are closed.
facts.quiet-room: It is a quiet interior with no one moving.

glosses.three-swords-wall: A fight hung on the wall for a while; tension set down.
glosses.stained-glass: A scene of receiving comfort and care shows in the window.

reversedGloss.blocked: He needs to rest but holds on without resting.
reversedGloss.waning: The recovery is over, and the time to move again nears.
reversedGloss.excess: The rest grows long, and he drifts away from the world.

misdescriptions.wrong: A corpse pierced by swords lies there.
All four swords hang on the wall.
